name: smwgraphics-undertale-snowdin-forest
title: Undertale - Snowdin Forest
description:
The tall trees from the forest area of Snowdin, the area where you first meet Sans and Papyrus. The Layer 3 trees are meant to be used with Layer 3 priority enabled. The background colour in the screenshots of the Layer 3 trees has been changed so the trees are easier to see.

Mod Edit: if you would like to use the Layer 3 trees, it is recommended that you apply a patch such as Minimalist Status Bars or Sprite Status Bar to avoid cutoff.
